_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giogadores de Surround in una griglia de {width}x{height}.
Tui ses su giogadore {player_id}. Mòvidas bàlidas: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Obiettivu: subrabìvere a totus is àteros. Is rastros sunt mortales; is impàttos cun sa parete ochient; is impàttos frontales ochient totus is duos.

board.after_moves: Sa taula a pustis de movimentos simulantes: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Giogadore {player_id} est mortu pro una mossa invàlida.

outcome.survived_win: Su giogadore {player_id} est subrabìvidu; totu sos àteros si sunt isbarrados.
outcome.all_crashed: Totus sos giogadores si sunt isbarrados in su matessi tempus.
outcome.outlived: Su giogadore at subrabìvidu totu sos àteros.
outcome.turn_limit: Sa làcana de su giru est arribbada - chi at subrabìvidu prus a longu binchet.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Grupos de classìfica finale (dae su mègius a su peus): {groups}
